instruction: I am throwing a party for all of my coworkers and roommates upcoming Saturday night. I need return gifts for them. Buy fitness trackers on amazon with at least 4.1 rating, and with 7 or more reviews, one for each invitee, and make sure they reach home by the end of the day before the party.
notes: Current date is Wed 2023-05-24, so the party is Sat 2023-05-27 and the delivery deadline is end of Fri 2023-05-26. Invitees are the union of coworker and roommate contacts (phone.search_contacts with relationship filter, de-duplicated); their count is the runtime value of quantity-num-invitees. The two relationships are domain constants because add-to-cart must require both lookups to be done (no quantified preconditions allowed). amazon.search_products uses query="fitness tracker" and min_product_rating=4.1; amazon.show_product then verifies num_product_reviews >= 7 and that the expected delivery date is <= 2023-05-26 (product-verified). The whole quantity of one single product is added to the cart with clear_cart_first=true so the resulting order contains exactly that product and quantity. The order ships to the existing home address (no address is updated/deleted) and is paid with a saved card. supervisor.complete_task takes no answer; its record parameters mirror the goal fact (ordered fitness-tracker quantity-num-invitees home-address).
